captions.text: Hello, sun! Let's start the day!

character_lock: Croco, a chubby mint-green baby crocodile with a rounded head, short snout, peach-cream belly, rosy cheeks, big chocolate-brown eyes, a gentle closed-mouth smile with no visible teeth, short arms and legs, chunky tail, wearing orange dungaree overalls with two small wooden buttons and a yellow star embroidered on the front pocket. Soft 3D animated preschool style, gentle pastel lighting, friendly and calm.
description:
Croco wakes up, stretches up high and says hello to the sun. A calm morning routine for little ones.
For parents: practice morning greetings - "Good morning!", "Stretch up high!", "Hello, sun!"
#CrocosLittleWorld #GoodMorning #MorningRoutine #KidsShorts

id_history.event: planned 2026-11-04 17:10 MT (Claude project pipeline/v2-episodes); first committed to GitHub in this integration

learning_goal: Say good morning and follow a simple wake-up stretch routine
safety: No jumping on the bed; window stays closed; the sun is small in the corner (no staring at sunlight).
